feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Man charged after woman stabbed to death in Manchester
articles.summary: A 26-year-old man has been charged after a woman was stabbed to death in a Manchester street.

articles.title: Controversial Jackdaw gas field expected to be approved
articles.summary: The controversial Jackdaw gas field is expected to receive approval from energy secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh on Wednesday.

articles.title: Two men re-arrested on suspicion of assisting Iran after RAF Fairford incident
articles.summary: Two men have been re-arrested on suspicion of assisting Iran’s intelligence service over a suspected terror plot near RAF Fairford.

articles.title: Channels to close as BBC announces details of cuts
articles.summary: The BBC has confirmed it will close BBC Three, BBC Scotland and BBC Radio 4 Extra linear broadcast services in the spring of 2027.

articles.title: Neglect in hospital contributed to baby's meningitis death, jury rules
articles.summary: Neglect contributed to the death of a five-month-old girl who died from meningitis after opportunities were missed in hospital to save or prolong her life, an inquest jury has found.

articles.title: Report set to reveal vast scale of antisemitism in English schools
articles.summary: A landmark report is set to detail the vast scale of antisemitism in English schools and colleges, Sky News can reveal.
